row.notes: (Upgrades team model, owner). linear = sum over type metadata records (+0x1a38..+0x1a40 stride 0x20) of Car_Upgrades_CalcTypeMass; total = sum of the records' mass at full (+4); f = linear/total; returns linear + f*(f*target - linear) with target = Upgrades+0x50 ('Target mass at max'). Log channel VEHICLE_UPGRADES_MASS. Callers 0x142f5a5d0 (car mass for a pace/strategy estimate: fuel FuelTank+0x100 + Chassis Mass + this) and 0x142962f10 (garage/programme UI). It does not write the physics mass; the physics mass change is the radUpgradeWeightReduction block (Chassis/Mass op -).

verify.notes: V1238 linear = sum of CalcTypeMass over records +0x1a38..+0x1a40 (stride 0x20, type byte +0); total = sum of record +4; f = linear/total; returns (f*[+0x50]-linear)*f+linear (linear if total==0); logs VEHICLE_UPGRADES_MASS. Caller 0x142f5a5d0 also loads FuelTank+0x100 at 0x142f5a88c and Chassis.
V6082 name/log string and function size match the code; strings verified via cstr
